inputs.name: BHRD 2013 complete maximal-subgroup classification
inputs.statement: Main Theorem 2.1.1 and Section 8.1 authorize the complete Table 8.50 for Omega8+(q), interpreted via central preimages for the simple projective group.

inputs.name: Primitive prime divisor theorem
inputs.statement: p^(6f)-1 has a primitive prime divisor except p=2,6f=6; that excluded case gives q=2.
inputs.locator: BP author preprint physical page 2, definition and Zsigmondy statement; classical number-theoretic theorem retained.

inputs.name: Accepted torus construction
inputs.statement: X lies in Omega and has projective order (q^3+1)/(2,q-1), for arbitrary primitive g,h.

qualifications: BP is an author-hosted older preprint, not a claimed publisher final edition; author old-draft warning and current errata are pinned. No BP maximal-overgroup theorem is a premise here.

BHRD is the complete published 2013 book. Section 8.1 says the authors knew of no table errors at publication and advertises an errata list. The separately cited Cambridge errata URL returned 403 and was not acquired or read; no claim that later errata were checked or absent is made.
The table number of conjugacy classes is never used as the number of subgroups containing the selected element.
